An art style showing subjects through geometric shapes and multiple viewpoints.

A member of a senate, a lawmaking body

回家途中，一场突如其来的大雨把我们淋透了。

make up for a failure or restore a good reputation

an underwater weapon that propels itself towards a target

Intense anger caused by something deeply unfair or wrong

房东直接拒绝了我的请求，完全没有商量。
Rather than banning private cars outright, cities could encourage residents to use reliable and affordable public transport.
城市可以鼓励居民使用可靠且价格合理的公共交通，而不是全面禁止私家车。
an outright lie｜彻头彻尾的谎言
buy outright指一次付清；形容词常置于名词前。
难以想象的；不可接受的
too unlikely or unacceptable to imagine or consider seriously
Leaving our dog behind during the move was unthinkable.
搬家时丢下我们的狗是绝对不可接受的。
For many communities, closing the only local hospital would be unthinkable because residents depend on its services.
对许多社区来说，关闭当地唯一的医院是不可接受的，因为居民依赖其服务。
an unthinkable idea｜不可接受的想法
比unlikely语气更强，常含“根本不能接受”之意。
